title: Picture Matching & Letter Formation
subject: English Language
objectives: Practice writing small letters of the alphabet

blocks.caption: Find the differences in the pictures below.

blocks.md: Look at the two pictures carefully. Find all the things that are different between them.

Practice writing the small letters of the alphabet in your copy book:

**a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z**
**Remember:** Small letters are also called lowercase letters. Every capital letter has a small letter pair: A→a, B→b, C→c.

quiz.q: What is the small letter for 'A'?
quiz.explain: The small letter for A is a.

quiz.q: What is the small letter for 'G'?
quiz.explain: The small letter for G is g.
D is a capital letter; the rest are lowercase.
